records.name: Reed–Solomon–affine concatenated code

generatorMatrix.algorithm: Use rows alpha^i X^j for 0 <= i <= 15 and 0 <= j <= 64, and columns (a,y) in A x F_2^15. Emit entry H(alpha^i a^j)_y using carryless arithmetic modulo T^16+T^5+T^3+T^2+1.
generatorMatrix.runtimeBound: O(1040n)=O(n) fixed-word operations for the concrete instance.
generatorMatrix.runtimeProof: There are exactly 1040n entries. Each uses a bounded number of operations on 16-bit field elements, and the algorithm streams every entry in the prescribed order. The output itself has 1040n bits.

verification.summary: An independent theorem-level audit recomputed the field certificate, length, dimension, product distance, rate, and complete generator-matrix runtime.

reviews.summary: Accepted after independent finite-field recomputation and a line-by-line audit of the simpler Reed–Solomon–affine concatenation proof.

records.construction: Concatenate a degree-64 Reed–Solomon evaluation code on 32,768 explicit points of F_(2^16) with the binary [32768,16,16384] affine truth-table code.

records.name: First-order Reed–Muller code

generatorMatrix.algorithm: Enumerate x in F_2^30 in lexicographic order and emit the rows 1,x_1,...,x_30 evaluated at x.
generatorMatrix.runtimeBound: O(n log n) bit operations for 31n output bits and coordinate indexing.
generatorMatrix.runtimeProof: There are 31n output entries. Each entry is emitted after reading one indexed bit of x, and lexicographic incrementation costs O(log n) per column. Thus the complete matrix is emitted in O(n log n) time.

verification.summary: Both independent checks verify the affine-function dimension and balance argument.

reviews.summary: Recomputed the length, dimension, and exact minimum distance of RM(1,30).
Independently checked that every nonconstant affine function is balanced.

records.construction: Evaluate every affine Boolean function on F_2^30 in lexicographic point order.

lemmas.title: Affine balance
lemmas.statement: \text{Every nonconstant affine }f:\mathbb F_2^m\to\mathbb F_2\text{ has Hamming weight }2^{m-1}.

lemmas.title: Polynomial root bound
lemmas.statement: 0\ne f\in F[X],\,\deg f\le r\quad\Longrightarrow\quad|\{a\in F:f(a)=0\}|\le r.

lemmas.title: Affine truth-table code
lemmas.statement: H:F_2^{m+1}\to F_2^{2^m},\quad H(z)_y=z_0+\sum_{i=1}^m z_i y_i\quad\text{ is an }[2^m,m+1,2^{m-1}]_2\text{ injection}.
